caption: The drawing depicts three separate views of a gold ornamental jewelry object, possibly a brooch or pendant. At the top center of the composition, there is an oval-shaped piece colored in gold with some engraved decorative patterns, featuring a prominent red gemstone set in the middle surrounded by a leaf-like gold design. Below this, on the left, is a depiction of the same object shown hanging vertically, as if it is an earring, with a similar gold oval base decorated with patterns and the same central red gemstone, topped by a smaller, round gold fastening. To the right of this, there is a side view of the same earring, showing the partially rounded edge of the gold with the red gemstone visible and the fastening mechanism extending horizontally. The background is plain and light-colored, highlighting the detailed gold and red elements of the jewelry.
title: Pin and Earring Set
